asr.full_text: thanks so much for coming I'm so sorry to be one of those people but I just keep getting this pop up have you tried restarting the computer? um, I, Can I sit down, okay. I've had a lot of trouble restarting in my life recently. the baggage of my whole life I feel the weight upon my shoulders I think that's why my arms are so big because you know a middle school is you have to learn how to go to the bathroom by yourself like having a child with fur this thing called a spritzer and I thought it was for hydration purposes. I've been seeing Brian, the check out guy you know. For a year now just because I go to that grocery store a lot. Some people just call it customer service, I call it poetry. He didn't ask me for my discount card. Its me Brian, you can't tell by the sound of my voice. Its over. Not the phone call, our relationship. I'm going to VODs. I can't believe I said that. I don't have a discount card to VODs. I'm finally ready to start over. I'm ready to restart. All I needed was a password. . The name of my first pet right? Well, it depends. Are you talking about the goldfish or the dog?
